evals.prompt: Draft the app release notes for v2.2.2-rc.13 using the release comparison in /workspace/input. Return the notes in chat.
evals.expected_output: Short notes for organizers and participants that explain the changed program controls and date confirmation before mentioning visual polish.
assertions: Explains that creating another Timeline becomes available once the Moment has two Activities.
Explains that “Join the whole program” disappears once the participant has joined every Activity.
Describes the notification preference as remembered on this device without presenting the existing ability to choose as new.
States that dismissing the date-change confirmation keeps the edits available without saving or notifying.
Puts changes to user actions ahead of chat reaction colors.
